# Golden protocol lines for slice 1 parser tests.
# Format (once tests exist): each non-comment, non-empty line is a
# valid or invalid input; expected results live next to the parser.
#
# valid HELLO
HELLO
HELLO name=yazi pid=4123 pane=%3 cwd=/code/foo
HELLO name=ttybus pid=1 id=cli-9
# valid SUB/PUB
SUB files
UNSUB files
PUB files
PUB files main.go
PUB files {"path":"main.go","line":12}
# valid SEND / LIST
SEND yazi-1 files main.go
LIST
# valid daemon → client
OK
OK id=cli-9
OK n=3
MSG files main.go
ERR PEER no such id
PEER id=yazi-1 name=yazi pid=4123 pane=%3 cwd=/code/foo subs=files,build
